protocol.selection_basis: Question metadata only: difficulty, category, source-page distribution, and single/multi-page evidence.
protocol.development_policy: Inspect per-question DEV results and choose the retrieval configuration using DEV only.
protocol.test_policy: Do not generate or inspect per-question TEST experiment results until the winning configuration is recorded.

annotation_corrections_before_freeze.change: Canonical source page changed from 10 to 1 because the same author evidence occurs on both pages and the valid top-ranked cover evidence is on page 1.
